and WHEREAS, West End is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork,known as Lots 5,8,10 and p/o 11,in Block 1152 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (said land being herein collectively called the “West End Land"); and WHEREAS, Purchaser proposes to improve Purchaser's Land by demolishing Purchaser's Buildings and constructing thereon a new building (which new building, together with any future replacement thereof and/or additions thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Purchaser's New Building”and Purchaser's Land and Purchaser's New Building being herein collectively called the “Purchaser's Premises");
